_comment: Floors (percent) to stop regressions, not targets. Measured 2026-11-26 with unit + integration tests together (npm run test:coverage): src/auth lines 94.75 branches 75.84; src/authz lines 87.30 branches 70.73; src/workflow lines 96.57 branches 87.05. Each floor is the measured value rounded down, minus 1 point of margin for tests that skip on some machines. Raise them when coverage rises; never lower them to make a change pass.
